Newborns with risk factors for RSV severe LRTI (preterm infants, birth before the peak epidemic, multiparous mother)
outcome: Risk of developing very severe lower respiratory tract infection (VS-LRTI)
cohort: 578 infants born during the RSV epidemic season in France
finding: While lower antibody titers against the RSV N protein were found in newborns with risk factors for severe RSV LRTI, there was no association between these titers and protection against VS-LRTI.
mod_finding: Newborns with risk factors for RSV severe LRTI, including those born before the peak epidemic and to multiparous mothers, had significantly lower mean antibody titers against the RSV N protein, but there was no association between antibody titer and protection against VS-LRTI.
